objects.name: Progress Kemp LoadMaster Flaw Could Let Attackers Run Root Commands Pre-Auth
objects.description: A critical vulnerability in Progress Kemp LoadMaster can let an unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary commands as root on the appliance by sending a crafted request to its API. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-8037, carries a CVSS score of 9.8 according to ZDI. Progress published its advisory on June
